---
title: "NBA MVP MACHINE"
format: html
---

```{=html}





<div class="mvp-container">

<button class="mvp-btn" onclick="doSystem()">
PRESS TO GENERATE MVP
</button>

<div id="ball-container">
<img src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7a/Basketball.png" id="ball" width="120">
</div>

</div>

<div id="loader" style="display:none;">

<img src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7a/Basketball.png" class="ball">

<div class="loading-text">
<span id="percent">0%</span>
<p id="loadingMessage">Loading...</p>
</div>

<button id="continueButton" onclick="goToData()" style="display:none;">
Click to view data
</button>

</div>

<div id="dataContainer"></div>

<script>

function doSystem() {

  const loader = document.getElementById("loader");
  const loaderText = document.getElementById("percent");

  loader.style.display = "flex";

  let percent = 0;

  let interval = setInterval(() => {

    percent++;

    loaderText.textContent = percent + "%";

    if (percent >= 100) {

      clearInterval(interval);

      document.getElementById("percent").textContent =
        "100% Completed";

      document.getElementById("loadingMessage").textContent =
        "Data Loaded!";

      document.getElementById("continueButton").style.display =
        "block";

    }

  }, 10);
}

/*function goToData() {

  fetch("/mvp_prediction.html")
    .then(response => response.text())
    .then(html => {
      document.getElementById("dataContainer").innerHTML = "none";
    });
}*/

function goToData() {


 fetch("/mvp_prediction.html")
   .then(response => response.text())
   .then(html => {

     // 1. Parse HTML
     const parser = new DOMParser();
     const doc = parser.parseFromString(html, "text/html");

     const container = document.getElementById("dataContainer");

     // 2. Inject content
     container.innerHTML = doc.body.innerHTML;

     container.style.display = "block"; // show data container

     // 3. Keeps loader visible while positioning
     const loader = document.getElementById("loader");

    // 4. Scroll  (before hiding anything) even though its not working
    loader.scrollIntoView({
      behavior: "smooth",
      block: "start"
    });

    // 5. hides button after click to prevent multiple clicks
    document.getElementById("continueButton").style.display = "none";

    // 6. small delay before fading loader (smooth UX)
    setTimeout(() => {
      loader.style.opacity = "0.6";  // how much of the loader screen is visible after loading
    }, 300);

   });
}



</script>

```
